results.title: Iran World Cup 2026 Squad, Fixtures, Standings, and Kits | FWC LIVE
highlights:
Iran confirmed their FIFA World Cup 2026 squad after the final roster submission window closed on June 2, 2026. The official squad list below is synced with the published final roster, while previous non-selected cards remain available under Extra Players for reference.
[...]
Amir Ghalenoei's Iran are built around defensive control, physical midfield work, and direct service into experienced attackers. The usual shape can look like a 4-4-2 or 4-2-3-1, with Saeid Ezatolahi and Saman Ghoddos helping the side manage central areas. Iran do not need to dominate possession to create danger because Taremi, Ghayedi, and Mohebi can attack quickly after turnovers.
[...]
The March squad gives Ghalenoei a deep domestic core, several Gulf-based players, and European-based options such as Taremi, Gholizadeh, Jahanbakhsh, and Dennis Eckert. Against Belgium, Egypt, and New Zealand, Iran's tournament plan should lean on compact defending and fast transitions. Set pieces also matter because Kanaanizadegan, Khalilzadeh, and Taremi give Team Melli strong aerial targets.
[...]
### Iran Probable Lineup (4-4-2)
[...]
Iran can use two forwards when Ghalenoei wants Taremi close to another penalty-box runner. The same shape can also become a compact 4-5-1 when protecting a lead.

Senegal is likely to deploy a 4-3-3 formation, which allows them to leverage their strong defensive line and dynamic wingers. The presence of experienced defenders like Kalidou Koulibaly and Abdoulaye Ndiaye provides a solid foundation at the back. In midfield, the combination of Idrissa Gueye and Pape Gueye offers both defensive stability and creative passing options. The wide areas will be crucial, with Sadio Mané and Ismaila Sarr expected to provide pace and width, stretching opposition defenses and creating space for the central striker. Senegal's playing style is characterized by quick transitions, high pressing, and exploiting the flanks, making them a formidable opponent for any team.
[...]
Sadio Mané remains Senegal's talisman, bringing experience, leadership, and a goal-scoring threat from the left wing. His ability to influence games with his dribbling and finishing will be vital. Kalidou Koulibaly anchors the defense with his commanding presence and leadership qualities, ensuring the backline remains organized and resilient. In midfield, Idrissa Gueye's work rate and tactical intelligence provide balance, allowing Senegal to control the tempo of the game. Ismaila Sarr's pace and directness on the right wing will be crucial in breaking down defenses and creating opportunities for the forwards. These players form the backbone of Senegal's World Cup campaign, each playing a pivotal role in their respective areas.
